features.name: Audit closes a plan-route feature with no PRD
features.description:
Audit closes a plan-route feature with no PRD - feature F-1 of workplan fix-audit-build-plan-route-close.
For a feature routed through /plan (a light TRD, no PRD by design), /audit-build ends with 0 defects, 0 test gaps and one uncovered item whose only content is 'no source supplied'. audit-rounds.js decide() returns close:false while uncovered > 0, so closed.json is never written. Make a missing PRD a caveat in the verdict, not an uncovered requirement, so the audit closes the feature when every TRD objective is covered. GitHub issue FortiumPartners/ensemble-vnext#83.
Acceptance: (1) a plan-route audit with no PRD, 0 defects, 0 test gaps and only the no-PRD item closes and keeps the caveat in the verdict; (2) a feature WITH a PRD and an uncovered requirement stays open; (3) a no-PRD audit with a real uncovered TRD objective stays open; (4) a no-PRD audit with a real defect still chains a fix run; (5) .claude/lib/audit-rounds.js stays identical to packages/core/lib/audit-rounds.js.
Builds on: none.
Decisions: where to mark the no-PRD finding as a caveat (at the source in audit-build.js or in tally): the implementer takes the smaller change (owner's call, taken by Forge, 2026-11-08).
Design: packages/core/workflows/audit-build.js:241 and :566-585; packages/core/lib/audit-rounds.js:99-100 and :166; tests packages/core/lib/audit-rounds.test.js and packages/core/workflows/audit-build.test.js.
Scope: this feature only. Other features of the plan are built separately; reference them as existing or to-come, never build them.
